01 · The House

Built around the bakery counter.

Every box we cut, fold and stamp starts with the same question — how does it look when it leaves the bakery door?

Kalash Packaging is a small manufacturing house in Naroda GIDC, Ahmedabad. We focus on a narrow, opinionated range: window boxes that stay crisp under display lights, MDF boards that keep a cake level, and cutlery kits that finish a celebration.

Enduring Quality

Heavyweight stock, clean creases and windows that stay clear end-to-end.

Consistent Supply

Standard sizes stocked year-round; custom runs scheduled against firm lead times.

Timely Dispatch

Orders move from Naroda GIDC across India on predictable weekly cycles.

Bakery-First Design

Every product answers to a real bakery use-case — not a generic SKU catalog.

02 · Signature Range

Top Window boxes.

The everyday classic — dressed up.

A top-panel window that shows off the cake without the lid coming off. Built on heavy, smooth stock with a clean die-cut window. Stackable, brandable, and ready for the shelf.

04 · Special Feature

Foil-stamped window branding.

For the bakeries that want their name on the glass. Our foil stamping lays a crisp metallic mark straight onto the window panel — a tiny detail that quietly re-orders how premium your whole product feels.

  • Stamp optionsLogo, brand name, Insta handle, phone number
  • FinishPremium foil, matte or mirror
  • MOQ1,000 boxes
  • SetupOne-time design & die charge
